question:
If all the vowels are dropped from the series, which symbol/number will be fifth to the right of the symbol/number thirteenth from right end?

D 2 U X 5 9 W @ E S B [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e1b4b47ae3ae53d68176e7f4f2abae592c14976a103c1049462cb96c2959f41.png] A # 3 Ω O M I R P 4 $ @ G & K 8 7 # N V % L A @ S ^ &

Given series:

D 2 U X 5 9 W @ E S B A # 3 Ω O M I R P 4 $ @ G & K 8 7 # N V % L A @ S ^ &

Condition to be checked:

1. Drop all vowels from the series.

2. Find the symbol/number which is fifth to the right of the symbol/number thirteenth from the right end.

**After dropping vowels:**

D 2 X 5 9 W @ S B # 3 Ω M R P 4 $ @ G & K 8 7 # N V % L @ S ^ &

**13th element from the right:**

D 2 X 5 9 W @ S B # 3 Ω M R P 4 $ @ G **&** K 8 7 # N V % L @ S ^ &

The 13th element from the right is &.

**5th element to the right of **&**:**

D 2 X 5 9 W @ S B # 3 Ω M R P 4 $ @ G **& K 8 7 #** **N** V % L @ S ^ &

The 5th element to the right of G is **N.**

Thus, N is the symbol/number fifth to the right of the symbol/number thirteenth from the right end.

Hence,**"**N**"** is the correct answer.
